''Lojban as a tool for encoding prose on the semantic web'' is a thesis by Brandon Wirick presented to The faculty of California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo, in November 2005.

It discusees possible conversion of the output of Lojban syntactical parsers to XML and RDF.
